name: Card Manager
description: Add and manage all your credit cards in one place. View each card's rewards, benefits, and spending limits.

name: Spending Tracker
description: Track all your transactions by category. See where your money is going across all your cards.

name: Subscription Manager
description: See all your recurring subscriptions and monthly charges in one place. Never get surprised by a forgotten subscription again.

name: Card Recommender
description: Tell us about a purchase or trip you're planning, and we'll recommend the best card to use based on your wallet.

name: Benefits Hub
description: View all the perks and benefits across your cards — credits, insurance, lounge access, and more — so you never leave money on the table.

name: Impulse Buy Checker
description: Activate a cooling-off timer before making an unplanned purchase. The app holds the intended amount in a savings bucket, giving you time to decide if you really want it.

name: Rewards Optimizer
description: See which card earns the most on your upcoming purchase category. Maximize your cashback and points without memorizing every card's rewards structure.
